subject: Bump to rc2 (#828)
reason: The change only edits the MODULE_RELEASE_STAGE macro in src/version.h from "rc1" to "rc2". A repo-wide search shows this macro is defined but never referenced anywhere else in valkey-search: module registration uses kModuleVersion (unchanged at 1.2.0), and RDB serialization and coordinator metadata versioning use kModuleVersion and the kRelease* constants, also unchanged. No command reply, INFO output, persisted data or wire format depends on the edited string, so there is no behaviour to exercise and no scenario is needed.
